title: 第3章 都是我的第4章 杀人诛心
slug: 模拟修仙杀我者恩人也
lines: 陈清月也没想到会有人不识字，表情无奈，还带着一丝不易察觉的烦躁。
“小翠，你教他识字修行。”
“七天之后我来验收成果。”
罗裙少女上前应声：“是，小姐。”
就这样，王易和周浩在这座偏僻的小院里住了下来。
他们在柳州城里凭空失踪，但陈府一切如常，好像什么都没有发生过。
第一天，王易就读完了《三煞鬼面书》。
不出所料，这本书就是一本纯粹的鬼修功法。
王易有些好奇，传闻中陈家三小姐被仙宗收进门内，手里怎么会有一本邪气森然的鬼修功法？
还专门回了家，暗中找人修炼？
这其中必有猫腻。
王易摇摇头，先把这件事放在心中，继续琢磨眼下的修行。
《三煞鬼面书》前后分为三个阶段。
初期，炼气一至三层，杀一人，炼人魂；
中期，炼气四至六层，杀两人，炼地魂；
后期，炼气七至九层，杀三人，炼天魂。
对于刚接触鬼修的凡人来说，最困难的一点就是如何感应捕捉到鬼气，然后压抑心中的抵触和恐惧，引鬼气入体。
但问题是，上哪儿去找鬼、见鬼、感应鬼气呢？
天上太阳高悬，王易陷入沉思。
“书上说，厉害的大鬼修都天生阴气，更有阴阳眼、鬼入梦、恶孽缠身等先天优势。”
这些东西对凡人来说是阴祸，但对鬼修来说却是不可多得的福报。
此谓阴祸得福。
“这些我都没有。”
王易不是天生鬼修，需要后天努力：“靠努力的话得常年走夜路、住阴宅、伴坟入睡，找鬼上身……”
但陈清月也吩咐过，王易和周浩都只能在这座院子里修行，不能离开半步。
“需要什么东西和柳翠讲，她会满足你们。”
百年药材，飞禽走兽，这些东西陈府里都有，但对王易来说毫无作用。
“我需要一个死人，一个刚死不久鬼魂未散的人。”
刚死的人，柳翠也能找到吗？
答案是不能。
柳翠不会去杀人，她一整天都在周浩身边，教他读书认字，一字一句的讲述《三煞鬼面书》上的内容。
那怎么办？
王易坐在屋檐下，沉思许久，目光闪烁，心里渐渐有了主意。
“先试试吧。”
他等到了天黑，一个人坐在庭院里。
content_en:
Chen Qingyue did not expect that there would be someone who was illiterate, with a helpless expression, and a hint of imperceptible irritation.
"Xiao Cui, teach him how to read and practice."
"I will come to check and accept the results in seven days."
The girl in the skirt stepped forward and responded: "Yes, Miss."
In this way, Wang Yi and Zhou Hao settled in this remote courtyard.
They disappeared out of thin air in Liuzhou City, but everything in the Chen Mansion remained as usual, as if nothing had happened.
On the first day, Wang Yi finished reading "Three Evil Ghost Faces".
As expected, this book is a pure ghost cultivation technique.
Wang Yi was a little curious. It was rumored that the third lady of the Chen family was taken in by the Immortal Sect. How could she have an evil ghost cultivation technique in her hand?
You even went home specifically to find someone to practice in secret?
There must be something fishy about this.
Wang Yi shook his head, put this matter in his mind first, and continued to think about his current practice.
"Three Evil Ghost Face Book" is divided into three stages.
In the early stage, in the first to third levels of Qi refining, kill one person and refine the person's soul;
In the middle stage, from the fourth to sixth levels of Qi refining, kill two people and refine the earth soul;
In the later stage, at the seventh to ninth levels of Qi refining, kill three people and refine the heavenly soul.
For ordinary people who are new to ghost cultivation, the most difficult point is how to sense and capture the ghost energy, and then suppress the resistance and fear in the heart to attract the ghost energy into the body.
But the question is, where can I go to find ghosts, see ghosts, and sense ghost energy?
The sun was high in the sky, and Wang Yi fell into deep thought.
"The book says that powerful ghost cultivators are born with yin energy, and have innate advantages such as yin and yang eyes, ghosts in dreams, and being haunted by evil spirits."
These things are evil to mortals, but they are rare blessings to ghost cultivators.
This is called a blessing out of misfortune.
"I don't have any of these."
Wang Yi is not born to be a ghost cultivator, he needs to work hard: "If you work hard, you will have to walk at night, live in shady houses, sleep with graves, and find ghosts..."
But Chen Qingyue also ordered that Wang Yi and Zhou Hao could only practice in this courtyard and could not leave even half a step.
"If you need anything, tell Liu Cui and she will satisfy you."
Centuries-old medicinal materials, birds and animals were all available in Chen's mansion, but they had no effect on Wang Yi.
"I need a dead person, someone who has just died and is still a ghost."
Can Liu Cui find the person who just died?
The answer is no.
Liu Cui doesn't know how to kill people. She stays with Zhou Hao all day long, teaching him how to read and write, and narrating the contents of "Three Evil Ghost Face Book" word by word.
What to do?
Wang Yi sat under the eaves, meditating for a long time, his eyes flickering, and he gradually came up with an idea.
"Let's try it first."
He waited until dark and sat alone in the courtyard.
